attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Puerto Rico territory income tax calculation. Implements separate PR tax system with progressive rates. Bona fide residents exempt from US tax on PR-source income. Act 60 provides 0% capital gains for investors, 4% business tax. Form 8898 required for bona fide residents.

condition_details.condition_comment: Qualifies for Act 60 business benefits; Act 60 business (4% rate)
